changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE comment ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, date_time TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, comment TEXT, teacher_id BIGINT, CONSTRAINT fk_comment_user FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES "user"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE --CONSTRAINT fk_comment_teacher --FOREIGN KEY (teacher_id) REFERENCES teacher(id) --ON DELETE SET NULL );
